PROJECTS

Lifelong Learning
in Action

EKE began with a simple desire to bring the life-changing experiences of international learning back home to Bitola. Today, that original spark has matured into a trusted network of educators, researchers, and community change-makers. We believe that learning is a continuous process that belongs to everyone, which is why we build inclusive projects where every participant is seen, heard, and supported.

The value of our work lies in the practical footprints we leave behind in our communities. Through creative workshops, street sports, and international mobility, we provide local leaders with the resources they need to run purposeful activities independently. Exploring our project history and specialized outputs shows exactly how these sustainable, local roots help us build a more resilient society.

PROGRAMS

How International
Exchange Builds
The Foundation For
Our Local Initiatives

Founded in Bitola by alumni of the Erasmus+ program, EKE grew out of a desire to share the horizon-expanding experiences we gained abroad with our own community. Since 2012, our team has grown that early vision into a reliable network of European partnerships, welcoming community spaces, and hands-on international learning programs.

We design projects that meet people exactly where they are. Rather than keeping European ideals confined to policy papers, we bring them to life in workshops, creative training, and community initiatives. Each program listed below represents a distinct chapter of that ongoing effort.

European Solidarity Corps

The European Solidarity Corps stands as the European Union’s primary funding framework for volunteering and solidarity initiatives across Europe and neighboring regions. Open to young adults aged 18 to 30, the program fully structures cross-border placements lasting anywhere from 2 weeks to 12 months, intentionally designed to eliminate financial barriers by fully covering accommodation, pocket money, travel, and health insurance.
